equations.coupled: J=P_m(T)*[max(p_s,p_p)^n_m-p_p^n_m]; p_s=p_r*(x-rho*z)/(1-rho*z)-J/k; z=J*A/Fmol; rho=0.5; k=exp(theta_m)*gasfactor*(F/5)^0.6*(T/673.15)^1.75. Positive bounded root; numerical pressures are absolute bar. Positive tabulated K_m=exp(theta_m).
equations.interpretation: Implicit positive root combining established membrane permeation, effective film resistance and average depletion. Effective conductance does not identify a unique causal mechanism.
